description: This file defines the AdmonitionRenderer class, which implements the NodeRendererInterface and provides rendering logic for admonition blocks within Markdown content using the League\CommonMark library.

classes.name: AdmonitionRenderer
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering admonition blocks in Markdown content, converting them into HTML elements with appropriate classes and titles.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders an admonition node into an HTML 'div' element with classes and optional title, using a child node renderer.
